description: Contest one job on the buyer's tab before its settlement cycle captures. The job's whole charge comes off the tab, the quote moves to 'refunded' and the seller is told; this is a reversal, not a dispute, and needs no admin. Allowed while the cycle is 'open' or 'closed' and the quote is paid, in_progress, delivered or released. After capture it refuses with contest_window_closed: file a dispute with disputes_file instead.

reason.description: Why the job is contested; the seller sees it.

service_quote_id.description: UUID of the tab job's quote thread.
